name: dashboard-design
description: Clean, honest, wordless dashboard UI for Claude Code: KPI cards, charts, heatmaps, bullet graphs, comparison periods, ranked breakdowns, date range pickers, filters, empty states, wide and phone layouts, and a screenshot QA pass with a words audit and a salience test. Target tiles, stat strips and hatched movement bars (2.1); new in 2.2: ten playbooks (SaaS, product, e-commerce, ads, AI usage, ops, support, finance, school), eight named layouts, funnels, cohort grids, uptime bars, leaderboards, chart annotations, and a study of 64 dashboard posts by designers on X. Distilled from 127 shipped dashboards and the field's classics (Few, Tufte, Knaflic, NN/g).
